metadata.question: Was the primary direction of the Eyjafjallajökull volcanic plume toward the north rather than the south on May 10, 2010?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use Sentinel-5P for atmospheric aerosols/SO2, or MODIS for aerosol optical depth - Since this is 2010, Sentinel-5P (launched 2017) won't work - Use MODIS Terra/Aqua aerosol products or SO2 data - Location: Eyjafjallajökull volcano in Iceland (~63.63°N, -19.62°W) - Date: May 10, 2010 2. Masking strategy: - We want to see the plume, so no cloud masking - Look at aerosol optical depth or SO2 distribution - Compare concentrations north vs south of the volcano 3. Logic: - Calculate mean aerosol/SO2 values in regions north and south of volcano - If north value > south value significantly, answer A (Yes) - If south value > north value, answer B (No) - Handle C1/C2/C3 cases appropriately ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const volcanoPoint = ee.Geometry.Point([-19.62, 63.63]); // Define regions: north and south of volcano (50km radius each) const northRegion = ee.Geometry.Point([-19.62, 64.13]).buffer(50000); // ~50km north const southRegion = ee.Geometry.Point([-19.62, 63.13]).buffer(50000); // ~50km south const startDate = '2010-05-10'; const endDate = '2010-05-11'; // 2. Data Acquisition - MODIS Aerosol for volcanic plume detection let aerosolCol = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MCD19A2_GRANULES') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(volcanoPoint); console.log('MCD19A2 Images:', aerosolCol.size().getInfo()); // Fallback to older MODIS aerosol product if (aerosolCol.size().getInfo() === 0) { aerosolCol = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD08_D3') .filterDate(startDate, endDate); console.log('MOD08_D3 Images:', aerosolCol.size().getInfo()); } // Another fallback to Terra/Aqua combined if (aerosolCol.size().getInfo() === 0) { aerosolCol = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MCD19A2_GRANULES') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(volcanoPoint); console.log('MCD19A2_061 Images:', aerosolCol.size().getInfo()); } if (aerosolCol.size().getInfo() === 0) { console.log('No data available for May 10, 2010.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 3. Processing - get aerosol optical depth const aerosolImage = aerosolCol.median(); const aodBand = aerosolImage.select(['Optical_Depth_055']).multiply(0.001); // Scale factor // Check for valid pixels in both regions const northCount = aodBand.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: northRegion, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('Optical_Depth_055'); const southCount = aodBand.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: southRegion, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('Optical_Depth_055'); const northCountVal = await northCount.getInfo(); const southCountVal = await southCount.getInfo(); console.log('North pixels:', northCountVal, 'South pixels:', southCountVal); if (!northCountVal || !southCountVal || northCountVal === 0 || southCountVal === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels in one or both regions.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 4. Calculation - mean AOD in each region const northMean = aodBand.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: northRegion, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('Optical_Depth_055'); const southMean = aodBand.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: southRegion, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('Optical_Depth_055'); const northVal = await northMean.getInfo(); const southVal = await southMean.getInfo(); console.log('North AOD:', northVal); console.log('South AOD:', southVal); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (northVal === null || southVal === null || isNaN(northVal) || isNaN(southVal)) { console.log('Calculation failed - invalid values.'); console.log('C3'); return; } console.log('North/South ratio:', (northVal / southVal).toFixed(2)); // If northern AOD is greater, plume went north if (northVal > southVal) { console.log('Primary plume direction: NORTH'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('Primary plume direction: SOUTH'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
